relevance_rank_note: Directly measures ApoE4 vs ApoE3 binding to a recycling receptor (insulin receptor) by affinity and co-IP, plus IR surface level, endosomal co-localisation and recycling, in mouse neurons and a human neuroblastoma line.

description: Solid-phase binding of biotinylated human insulin receptor to immobilised recombinant apoE3 or apoE4 gave a lower dissociation constant for apoE4, i.e. apoE4 bound IR with higher affinity than apoE3. Effect detail: Kd read off the bars, apoE3 ~415 nM vs apoE4 ~190 nM (Kd ~54% lower with apoE4 = tighter binding).
quote: we found that both recombinant apoE3 and apoE4 specifically bound to IR with apoE4 having higher binding affinity than apoE3 (Figure 5A)
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (tighter apoE binding to insulin receptor, lower Kd)
system: Cell-free solid-phase binding ELISA; recombinant human apoE3 or apoE4 (Fitzgerald) coated at 400 ng/well, biotinylated human insulin receptor (R&D) 0-700 nM, 24 h at 4 C, neutral pH; Kd from one-site specific binding; three independent experiments. cell-free assay with recombinant non-lipidated apoE and purified receptor, not human brain cells.
human_check: Kd values are shown only as bar heights in Fig 5A (apoE3 ~410 nM vs apoE4 ~190 nM by eye); no numeric Kd is printed in the text or legend, so eff is left qualitative. The single star on Fig 5A maps to the legend key *p < 0.05; confirm the star sits on the E3-vs-E4 bracket.

description: Recombinant apoE and IR were co-incubated in solution, apoE was immunoprecipitated, and more IR was recovered with apoE4 than with apoE3 (IR/apoE ratio normalised to apoE3).
quote: We found that more IR was co-immunoprecipitated with apoE4 than with apoE3 (Figure 5C)
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more insulin receptor co-immunoprecipitated with apoE)
system: Cell-free solution binding; recombinant human apoE (1 uM) and human IR protein (400 nM) incubated 1 h at 37 C in PBS at neutral pH, apoE pulled down with biotin-conjugated anti-apoE antibody, IR detected by immunoblot; three independent experiments. cell-free co-IP of purified recombinant proteins, not human brain cells.
human_check: The IR/apoE ratio bar for apoE4 sits at ~1.8 with apoE3 normalised to 1.0 in the Fig 5C quantification; no number is printed. Star on the E3-E4 bracket read against the Fig 5 legend key *p < 0.05.

description: Binding of astrocyte-secreted lipidated apoE lipoprotein particles to IR was also tighter for apoE4 than apoE3, with both roughly ten-fold higher affinity than the corresponding recombinant proteins. Effect detail: Kd read off the bars, apoE3 ~47 nM vs apoE4 ~19 nM (Kd ~60% lower with apoE4).
quote: we found that apoE4 lipoprotein particles bind to IR more strongly than apoE3 lipoprotein particles (Figure 5B)
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (tighter lipidated apoE binding to insulin receptor)
system: Cell-free solid-phase binding ELISA; lipidated apoE3 or apoE4 particles purified from conditioned medium of astrocytes, coated 400 ng/well, biotinylated human IR 0-700 nM, 24 h at 4 C, neutral pH; three independent experiments. cell-free assay using astrocyte-secreted mouse-culture apoE particles and purified receptor, not human brain cells.
human_check: Kd bars in Fig 5B are ~47 nM (apoE3) vs ~20 nM (apoE4) by eye; no numbers printed. Two stars read against the Fig 5 legend key **p < 0.01.

description: In SH-SY5Y cells expressing IR-GFP without insulin, IR-GFP co-localisation with transferrin-labelled endosomes was higher after apoE4 treatment than after apoE3, i.e. the receptor was retained in the endosomal compartment with apoE4.
quote: we found that nearly 20% of IR-GFP co-localized with transferrin in the endosomal compartment in apoE4-treated cells whereas less co-localization was observed in apoE3-treated cells
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more insulin receptor co-localised with transferrin endosomes)
system: Human SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma cells transfected with human IR-GFP, treated overnight with 100 nM recombinant apoE3 or apoE4 without insulin, Alexa Fluor 568 transferrin 20 ug/ml for 1 h, confocal co-localisation; three independent experiments. immortalised human neuroblastoma line with overexpressed tagged receptor and exogenous recombinant apoE, not primary non-aged human brain cells.
human_check: Fig 6D minus-insulin bars read ~8% (apoE3) vs ~21% (apoE4); the text prints only the apoE4 value, so eff kept qualitative. Three stars over the minus-insulin pair map to ***p < 0.001 in the Fig 6 legend.

description: Cell-surface biotinylation of apoE-null mouse cortical neurons showed apoE4, but not apoE3, lowered the surface-to-total IR ratio in the absence of insulin.
quote: In the absence of insulin stimulation, we found that apoE4 but not apoE3 significantly reduced the amount of cell surface IR (Figures 5G, H)
system: Primary cortical neurons from Apoe-/- mouse embryos (E16-18), DIV10, treated overnight with 100 nM recombinant apoE3 or apoE4 without insulin, sulfo-NHS-SS-biotin surface labelling and immunoblot; three independent experiments. embryonic mouse Apoe-null neurons given exogenous recombinant apoE, not human brain cells.
human_check: Fig 5H minus-insulin bars: E3 ~98%, E4 ~73% of untreated vehicle; no printed percentage, so eff qualitative. The E3-vs-E4 bracket in Fig 5H carries one star, legend key *p < 0.05; a separate V-vs-E4 bracket carries two stars - make sure the recorded P is the E3/E4 one.

description: A biotin-cleavage recycling assay in apoE-null cortical neurons left more internalised IR inside apoE4-treated cells at 30 and 60 min, indicating slower return of IR to the surface with apoE4.
quote: significantly higher amount of intracellular IR was detected in apoE4-treated cells compared with cells treated with apoE3 at 30 minutes and 60 minutes, indicating that apoE4 impaired IR recycling (Figure S8B)
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (slower insulin receptor recycling to the surface)
system: Primary cortical neurons from Apoe-/- mouse embryos (E16-18), surface biotinylated at 4 C, 100 nM recombinant apoE3 or apoE4 for 30 min at 37 C to internalise, surface biotin stripped by glutathione, recycling followed as loss of internalised biotinylated IR at 30 and 60 min. embryonic mouse Apoe-null neurons with exogenous recombinant apoE, not human brain cells; panel is in the supplement, which was not available to read.
human_check: Figure S8B is in the supplement, which is not in the local files; the Results text states significance but prints no P, effect size or n. A person should open Figure S8B to fill eff/p/n.

description: In the same surface biotinylation experiment, apoE3 and apoE4 did not differ in cell-surface or total LRP1, a canonical apoE recycling receptor, nor in NMDAR, AMPAR or Na-K-ATPase.
quote: No significant differences were found in the levels of cell surface and total LRP1, NMDAR, AMPAR, and Na-K-ATPase after apoE3 and apoE4 treatments
system: Primary cortical neurons from Apoe-/- mouse embryos (E16-18), DIV10, treated overnight with 100 nM recombinant apoE3 or apoE4, sulfo-NHS-SS-biotin surface labelling and immunoblot for LRP1, NMDAR, AMPAR, Na-K-ATPase. embryonic mouse Apoe-null neurons with exogenous recombinant apoE, not human brain cells; panels are in the supplement, which was not available to read.
human_check: Null for surface LRP1, recorded as against. Supplementary Figures S7A, C-F, H-K are not in the local files; the Results text states no significant difference but prints no P or n. Location given as S7C (the surface LRP1 panel per the text's panel list) - a person should confirm which sub-panel is surface LRP1.
